scope: All4834 Dev frames and all registered84 new cases. Seed means average three official combined-video scores, not the two per-sequence scores. Sample standard deviation over3 seeds is descriptive, not a significance test.
selection: Common fullcue epoch/policy chosen by3-seed mean Dev. Head-role evaluation uses the preregistered prior seed0 epochs across every seed, with no new per-seed role epoch selection. Retain every failed control. NMS/emission factorial and original-parent removals are still separate pending evidence.
